claims.claim_text: The Fight Fascist State Repression and ICE resolution proposes making immigrant defense an organizational priority through a national Abolish ICE campaign, supporting local and state abolitionist campaigns, and strengthening Red Rabbits and infrastructure to support comrades facing repression.
The Building a United Front Toward 2028 resolution proposes that DSA explore building a broad Left-Labor electoral coalition capable of organizing the foundation of independence from the duopoly.

The Building a United Front Toward 2028 resolution proposes directing DSA to convene a 2028 Planning Committee to explore organizing strategies, liaise across national bodies, and build local chapter preparedness.
